quotes.title: KELT-1
quotes.card: KELT-1 is a F-type main-sequence star.
quotes.introduction: Its surface temperature is 6518±50 K. It is similar to the Sun in its concentration of heavy elements, with a metallicity Fe/H index of 0.008±0.073, but is much younger at an age of 1.75±0.25 billion years.
